text:
The abstract describes synthesis and characterization of a polyacrylamide‑titanium dioxide (PAA@TiO₂) nanocomposite and its use as an adsorbent for crystal violet. It reports adsorption capacity, experimental conditions, and molecular‑level simulation results. None of the four candidate hypotheses involve this material or its described mechanism; they propose entirely different adsorbents (treated wheat straw, MWCNT‑biochar with bacteria, Ag‑nanoparticle biochar, and acid‑treated hemp shiv). Therefore, the study’s evidence does not support any of the proposed hypotheses.
